pieces.Text: You were infested with hive larvae (likely from a hive larva swarm; see page 236), but your body has metabolized the larvae and mutated you into something new. A hive infestation increases over time as your body adapts. Each month, your infestation surges at unpredictable intervals a number of times equal to your manifestation level. Each episode lasts about an hour, during which you're racked by pain and must attempt a Fortitude save (DC
). On a success, you weather the episode. If you fail, your corruption progresses to the next stage, but you don't need to attempt any further saves until the next month.
circumstance bonus on saving throws related to the corruption progressing.
